thread:
Maya Patel: quick run-through of the routing rules editor after the preview sim. found a few UX/accessibility items.
Liam Chen: ready for the list.
Maya Patel: 1) Inconsistent label: some screens use 'Order' and others use 'Priority'. Pick one.
Samir Rao: backend uses 'priority' so prefer that everywhere.
Eva Gomez: 2) Validation messages are vague. Instead of 'Rule conflict detected' show which rule and a suggested fix.
Liam Chen: e.g. 'Conflict with rule #4 — overlapping condition. Click to view or reorder.' + link to focus the conflicting rule.
Maya Patel: 3) Keyboard reordering: Tab currently skips the handle. Keyboard users can't move rules.
Liam Chen: make the handle a focusable button with aria-label='Move rule' and allow arrow keys to reposition while focused. announce new position via aria-live.
DesignBot: a11y note: use role='button', aria-grabbed or aria-pressed patterns and live region updates.
Maya Patel: 4) Status badge contrast: small 'active' badge fails AA. Options: darker color or bolder text.
Samir Rao: I'll try darker color + icon (aria-hidden) while keeping text for screen readers.
Maya Patel: 5) Preview stats: when 'simulate caching' is on we only show token time. PMs want batch size and estimated latency visible.
Liam Chen: propose compact row: 'Batch: 8 | Est latency: 120ms | Cache hit: 32%'. Show whenever simulation toggles enabled.
Eva Gomez: copy tweaks: button 'Save rules' -> 'Save and apply'. Rule tooltip -> 'Applied at routing time; affects model and region selection.'
Maya Patel: visual focus: hover/focus on rule cards is subtle. increase elevation + add 2px focus border.
Maya Patel: final: validation modal should list multiple errors and include anchors to each offending rule.
Liam Chen: validator will return array of {ruleId, message}. UI will render summary with links that scroll+focus cards.
Maya Patel: action owners: Liam - keyboard reorder + preview stats. Samir - contrast + hover visuals. Eva - copy + validation copy. Maya - detailed validation strings and link behavior.
Samir Rao: I'll upload a short Figma update shortly.
Liam Chen: I'll add keyboard E2E and a snapshot for preview stats.
DesignBot: visual-regression queued for rules-editor-a11y-v2.
Maya Patel: aiming for a small patch for beta next week. ack?
Liam Chen: ack
Samir Rao: ack
Eva Gomez: ack
Maya Patel: thanks everyone.
